purpose: Brand-context definitions of SOCC's gates. Every frontier must pass its assigned gates before it can be accepted and the next frontier unlocked. Gates turn branding from taste into proof.

SCIENTIFIC_QUALITY_GATE.question: Is this decision evidence-based and falsifiable — not just taste?
checks: decision_traceable_to_strategy (visual follows positioning, not vice versa)

HERMES_GATE.question: Does it actually render / work in reality?

CODEX_GATE.question: Does it conform to canon law and contracts?

GUARDIAN.question: Can independent skeptics refute this before we accept it?
GUARDIAN.mechanism: N adversarial agents each try to REFUTE the frontier (default to refuted=true when uncertain). Frontier survives only if a majority fail to refute.
GUARDIAN.kills: plausible-but-weak decisions, off-strategy visuals, accessibility failures, hype language

acceptance_rule: A frontier is ACCEPTED only when (all assigned gates PASS) AND (creator confirms). Until then status stays PENDING/REVIEW and the next frontier is LOCKED.
truth_boundary: Gate definitions only. Defines how frontiers are judged. Running this file judges nothing by itself; gates are applied per-frontier during forging.
